name: Teen Counseling
one_liner: Teen Counseling is BetterHelp's online therapy service for teens aged 13–19, with a licensed therapist by text, phone or video and parent consent.
best_for: Teens 13–19 who prefer messaging or phone
Families without insurance coverage for therapy
Privacy for the teen within a parent-paid plan

long_description: Teen Counseling is BetterHelp's online therapy service for teens aged 13–19, with a licensed therapist by text, phone or video and parent consent. A parent signs up and consents, then the teen is matched with a licensed therapist and talks with them by messaging, phone or video in a private room parents can't read. Self-pay subscription; no insurance. What it includes: Licensed therapists; Messaging, phone and video; Private teen room; Separate parent chat.

faqs.q: How much does Teen Counseling cost?
faqs.a: About $70–$100/week, billed every 4 weeks. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Teen Counseling before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Teen Counseling replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: Teen Counseling connects you with licensed professionals, so it can be a route into real care. It isn't an emergency service: if you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Teen Counseling?
faqs.a: Teen Counseling is available on iPhone, Android and the web.
